name: Special Topics in Inclusive Transportation
description: The course will focus on: (1) transport policies and their impact on underlying inequalities in society resulting from income, gender, disability, or residential location; (2) development patterns and their impact on accessibility, safety, social equity, gender equity, and environmental design; and (3) other considerations that impact transportation equity.
